AppleImage4's one-time security-flag initializer: it reads the init byte at 0x7cd6ee8, computes flags from the security-mode struct at 0x7cd7010/0x7cd7030, and caches status 2 + the flag word at 0x7cd6eec/0x7cd6ef0. The native __DATA_CONST placement overwrites those globals. iPhone26 panic: AppleImage4 called 0xabda26c from 0x8d05be4; the wrapper ignores the return and reads the status out-pointer.
